item.title: Civic leaders honored with 2026 Lifetimes of Achievement awards
item.description: They broke barriers, launched nonprofits and enriched the Palo Alto community in countless ways through fundraising, volunteering, improving food access and promoting civic engagement. And on Tuesday, seven individuals were heralded by Avenidas for their decades of contributions with Lifetimes of Achievement Awards, an annual honor bestowed on adults over 65. item.title: New polls show wavering support for Cubberley redevelopment
item.description: Palo Alto leaders may find themselves scrambling to fundraise for much-needed upgrades at the Cubberley Community Center after a recent poll confirmed that the city would likely not be able to pass a tax to do so in 2026.
